author: Nerdstalgic
description:
X-Men '97 had an near-impossible task...bring back one of the most beloved animated series of the '90s without losing what made it special in the first place. 

But rather than simply relying on nostalgia, the series found a way to make decades of X-Men stories feel fresh, relevant, and more emotionally powerful than ever. 

And then came an episode that brought everything together.  Packing everything that makes the X-Men special into one unforgettable episode.

#xmen #xmen97 #marvelanimation #avengersdoomsday #nerdstalgic
title: What Makes THIS The Perfect Episode of X-Men ’97
